meta.purpose: Single source for importing the current official class schedule without duplicate legacy/teacher-load tabs.

excluded_sheets.SHS: Do not import together with HS SCHED (NEW). Its FIRST TERM Grade 11/12 data is duplicated in HS SCHED (NEW), and it also contains SECOND TERM and THIRD TERM data.
excluded_sheets.HS SCHED: Legacy/older HS schedule containing overlapping sections and second-semester data. Do not merge with HS SCHED (NEW).
excluded_sheets.ISAL UPDATED: Teacher/faculty load timetable. Reference/validation only; do not import as additional section schedule records.
excluded_sheets.HS LOADS: Teacher/faculty load timetable. Reference/validation only; do not import as additional section schedule records.
excluded_sheets.Sheet6: Adviser lookup/reference only; not a timetable source.

import_rules.single_source_of_truth: Section schedules from ELEM + HS SCHED (NEW).
import_rules.faculty_timetable: Derive faculty timetable from imported section records. Do not independently import teacher-load tabs into the same schedule dataset.
import_rules.conflict_rule: After deduplication, flag a teacher conflict only when the same teacher is assigned to two DIFFERENT class records whose times overlap.
